testcase.name: Scenario: Select an origin axis from filtered browser results: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-workspace-layout-source/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:595:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select an origin axis from filtered browser results ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid ✔ And the model browser contains X Axis, Y Axis and Z Axis under Origin ✔ When the user opens browser search and enters "axis" ✔ Then the browser shows the three matching axes under Origin ✔ And the matching text is highlighted ✔ When the user selects X Axis in the filtered results ✔ Then the X Axis row is highlighted ✔ And its corresponding axis is highlighted in the viewport ✔ When the user clears the search using the search close control ✔ Then the unfiltered browser tree returns ✔ And X Axis remains selected and highlighted in the viewport ✔ When the user activates the search close control again ✔ Then the search field closes ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the axis highlight disappears from the viewport ✔ And the solid remains visible
